title: Interview with Google engineer who believed LaMDA was sentient
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Interview with Google engineer who believed LaMDA was sentient, about 2022–2023 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I interviewed the Google engineer that left because he thought that Lambda was or whatever

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that around 2022 or 2023 he interviewed the Google engineer who left the company because he believed LaMDA, a Google artificial intelligence chatbot, was conscious. Michels mentions it in a 2023 conversation about UFOs and religion, as part of a wider look at what counts as a non-human mind.
